title: Make a Meal findable by meaning, safely
objective: The migration that gives discovery its foundation: pgvector, the embedding column, the ranking function that runs as the caller, and area matching that ignores spelling.
acceptance_criteria: discovery_rls_test.sql written and SEEN TO FAIL before the migration exists, with fixtures containing a Meal of every status — the failure output recorded in the PR
search_meals is SECURITY INVOKER; making it SECURITY DEFINER on purpose turns cases 2-6 red, and it is put back
a Cook cannot write meals.embedding (case 9), and that case was seen to fail first
meals.embedding is vector(768) and NULLABLE — a Meal without one is invisible to search and still visible to browsing
EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows the HNSW index in the plan; a sequential scan returns correct answers slowly and no test catches it
normalise_area is IMMUTABLE, lives in SQL and nowhere else, and the migration REINDEXes if it changes
mutate-policies.py reports zero clauses with no assertion behind them, and weakening the kitchen and meals policies TOGETHER turns cases 7-8 red
notes:
grok-4.5 because this is the row the model table reserves for it: authorization and RLS. E3 adds no policy, which is exactly why this package is dangerous — every existing authorization test passes whether or not search leaks, because none of them travel a ranking path that did not previously exist. Two things must be broken on purpose here and both are in the acceptance criteria. The plan(N) line in discovery_rls_test.sql is declared shared: WP-017 adds cases to a different file, but any later package adding cases here edits this one line.

Do this package's work directly and do NOT dispatch to opencode-delegate or claude-delegate until the founder says otherwise. suggested_model and spend_envelope_usd are kept as the plan for when it resumes; they are not permission to spend today.

DELIVERED 2026-08-07 overnight. 27 assertions, several watched red first. rls-reviewer found a LIVE BYPASS — the embedding trigger tested current_user, which SECURITY DEFINER rewrites — and a bug in normalise_area that made two of the three cases its own comments name fail. Both fixed with assertions that were seen to fail. Three measurements replaced three assertions: HNSW refuses 3072 dims, a column-level REVOKE cannot carve a hole in a table grant, and the index IS in the plan.

OPEN AND NEEDING THE FOUNDER: (1) meals.embedding is SELECTable by anon — E2's table-level GRANT covers new columns automatically. Fixing it means revoke-then-regrant-by-column, which cannot be verified against PostgREST locally. The 420 KB browse payload half is fixed by naming columns in the client. (2) search_meals RETURNS SETOF public.meals, so it widens with the table; an explicit RETURNS TABLE is the fix. (3) CREATE EXTENSION vector landed in public rather than extensions, adding ~118 anon-reachable RPC endpoints — changing it risks diverging from the live project, which cannot be checked from here. (4) hnsw.ef_search defaults to 40 against LIMIT 50 with post-filters, so an area-narrowed search can return zero while matching Meals exist — which makes FR-024's promise sometimes untrue.
